title: StanceChangePenalties crouch/stand leaf join

leads.title: StanceChangePenalties crouch/stand leaf join
leads.summary: The 24 StanceChangePenalties leaves are elements of a 200-slot array (Field_fc724c05, 16 bytes per element) indexed 10 x from + to for Stand=0, Crouch=1, Prone=2, plus 100 for Zoomed; the sixteen directly named leaves fix that rule, so the eight crouch/stand leaves are exact (StandToCrouch at index 1/101, CrouchToStand at 10/110) and both directions hold identical values on all 63 weapons (0.3 s; 1.0 degree unzoomed with 0.2 and 0.5 exceptions, 0.2 degree zoomed), so the L120 values stand.
leads.reopenWhen: Reopen if a later build changes the array length or index rule.

assets.question: Where do the eight crouch/stand StanceChangePenalties leaves sit in the GS array?
assets.conclusion: Element size is 16 bytes: CrouchToProne (index 12) MinAngleOffset 6.0 at offset 3216; CrouchToStand (index 10) 1.0 degree / 0.3 s at 3184/3188 and StandToCrouch (index 1) 1.0 / 0.3 at 3040/3044; zoomed indices 110 and 101 hold 0.2 degree / 0.3 s at 4784/4788 and 4640/4644.

question: Are the eight crouch/stand StanceChangePenalties leaves exactly joined to their array slots, and do L120 values change?
sourceFacts: Inventory pointers /Field_fc724c05/<index>/{Field_ed10e827 Duration, Field_7ce404e6 MinAngleOffset}: the array has 200 slots on every GS; the sixteen directly named leaves sit at 12, 21, 20, 2 (unzoomed) and 112, 121, 120, 102 (zoomed): index = 10 x from + to, Stand 0, Crouch 1, Prone 2, +100 zoomed.
Registry name pairs for the crouch/stand leaves point at /Field_fc724c05/10 (CrouchToStand) and /1 (StandToCrouch), and the zoomed +100 slots.

Raw re-reads on GS_HK433 (scripts/frosty-raw-check.py, f32): StandToCrouch MinAngleOffset 3040=1.0; StandToCrouch Duration 3044=0.3; CrouchToStand MinAngleOffset 3184=1.0; CrouchToStand Duration 3188=0.3; Zoomed StandToCrouch MinAngleOffset 4640=0.2; Zoomed StandToCrouch Duration 4644=0.3; Zoomed CrouchToStand MinAngleOffset 4784=0.2; Zoomed CrouchToStand Duration 4788=0.3; CrouchToProne MinAngleOffset 3216=6.0; CrouchToProne Duration 3220=0.9
Across the 63 site weapons, slots 1 and 10 hold identical (Duration, MinAngleOffset) pairs, as do 101 and 110; the only other nonzero slots belong to KSG (not a site weapon).
inference: The eight crouch/stand leaves are exactly joined by the index rule; L120 read index 1 for both directions, which is harmless because both directions are equal. The L120 control offset 4640 is Zoomed StandToCrouch (index 101), not CrouchToStand (index 110 at 4784).
unresolved: Runtime meaning of the transitions and how they compose with the static spread minima.
siteImpact: None; removes the "candidate mapping" caveat from the L120 proposal.
